verdict.rationale: Twilio itself can answer calls, record them, and transcribe them, and a hands-on user confirms running voicemail-to-webhook with transcription. Getting the transcript into email or chat is not built in: a user reports TwiML bins and Functions have no email capability, so you must host your own code or use SendGrid. Missing for 10: turnkey delivery of voicemail transcripts to email or chat, first-party voicemail-transcription docs, a no-code setup path for founders.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: respond to incoming phone calls, gather user input, record calls, and take payments without needing a person to answer the phone
Turn voice and messaging interactions into valuable context with AI-powered language transcription and analysis.
They still use Twilio for voicemail-to-webhook with transcription.
